title: Intake & Security
description: Secure document ingestion via header-authenticated webhook, cryptographic verification, file size and MIME inspection, and initial 202/400 HTTP response.

title: Document Extraction & Evidence Store
description: Multi-format document parsing (PDF via PyMuPDF, DOCX via python-docx, XLSX via openpyxl), SHA-256 chunking, PII redaction, and database evidence registration.

title: Agent Orchestration (Agent 0)
description: Autonomous planning and task formulation by Agent 0, supported by PostgreSQL scoped session memory and Gemini/OpenRouter LLMs.

title: Document Intelligence & Personal Data ID (A1 & A2)
description: Contractual clause parsing by Agent 1 and Personal Data Inventory classification by Agent 2, backed by citation validation tools.

title: Processing Activities & RoPA Register (A3)
description: Construction of statutory Records of Processing Activities (RoPA) by Agent 3, linking business purposes, systems, and retention schedules.

title: Data Flow Analysis & Topology (A4)
description: Topological modeling of data movements between fiduciaries, processors, third parties, and databases by Agent 4.

title: DPDP Compliance Mapping (A5)
description: Benchmarking findings against the India DPDP Act 2023 statutory catalogue by Agent 5, classifying requirements into evidenced, gaps, or verification-needed.

title: Risk & Gap Assessment (A6)
description: Privacy risk rating and gap detection by Agent 6, generating actionable remediation roadmaps with severity scoring.

title: QA & Autonomous Self-Correction Loop (A7)
description: Senior reviewer gatekeeper Agent 7. Inspects package integrity, checks citations, and dynamically routes revision requests back to A3, A4, A5, or A6 up to 2 attempts.

title: Deterministic Mermaid DFD Generation
description: Deterministic JavaScript compilation of verified data flows into Level 0 and Level 1 Mermaid DFD diagrams for rendering into SVG and PNG.

title: Human Approval Gate & Reviewer Briefing (A8)
description: Executive briefing synthesis by Agent 8, compilation of HTML/Word review package with embedded SQL, and interactive n8n Wait approval gate with revision routing.

title: Reporting, Persistence & Final Delivery
description: Final consolidation and dispatch: FastAPI exports multi-tab Excel RoPA, compliance PDF matrix, rendered diagrams, and sends confirmation emails with attachments.

title: Error Handling & Centralized Auditing
description: Global workflow error trap. Sanitizes stack traces, notifies FastAPI job error API, and commits error states to PostgreSQL job audit logs.
